pm_review_routing_change.purpose: let an official task-scoped PM review root at the committed sprint baseline when no prior approval exists, binding the baseline to the committed state.json sprint/start_head
pm_review_routing_change.previous_approval: PMG-20261102-9c21daff covers head 9c21daf only; it does not cover e8b3baa
pm_review_routing_change.official_pm_review_at_candidate: Requested after this evidence commit; no approval recorded yet
pm_review_routing_change.round2_finding: PM review 82014858-e5aa-47bc-8004-853225d65b86 returned MAJOR: the baseline came from mutable current-HEAD state.json, so a committed redefinition could shrink a first-task review range
pm_review_routing_change.round2_fix: baseline must equal the start_head of the earliest commit that introduced the sprint id, that baseline must precede the creation commit, and the creation commit must precede the reviewed HEAD
pm_review_routing_change.artifact_digest_tolerance: a recorded digest is accepted only when Git can reproduce it for the approved revision, or when it hashes the artifact on disk and that artifact equals the committed blob under CRLF/LF normalisation; approvals also record artifacts_canonical. The digest is never ignored (PM MAJOR-01 on request 993fd4c2-3bea-4214-88c4-1e4cc9864556).
pm_review_routing_change.packet_bound: evidence sections are capped at 2,500 chars per file (1,000 head) and 11,000 chars total so the review stays inline; the diff and the task/base/head metadata are never truncated and every evidence file keeps its sha256
